stories.deck: FOOTBALL AT THE BOWL. THE RESULT HAS BEEN ENTERED ON BOTH FILES.
THE LICENSING OFFICER HAS ORDERED IT. INDOORS FROM 22:00 TO 06:00.
EVERYTHING FLOWS OUT. NOTHING IS REPLACED. FISHING SPOTS ARE MARKED. THE WATER IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR YOU.
THE DISTRICT'S MOOD STANDS AT -46. THE PREFECT HAS BEEN INFORMED. THE PREFECT WAS ALREADY THERE.
PROCESSED, HOUSED AND EMPLOYED. NOBODY WAS ASKED.
RECORD STORE IN BOARDWALK EAST, UNIT 1. THE DEPARTMENT HAS ISSUED A LICENCE AND AN EXPIRY DATE.

classifieds.text: CYCLE 2 OPENS WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 7, 14:34. STAND, VOTE, OR WRITE IN WHOEVER THE DEPARTMENT DID NOT EXPECT.

classifieds.title: THE ASSEMBLY SITS: SESSION 002
classifieds.text: THE BALLOT IS OPEN UNTIL 05:48 ON TUESDAY, OCTOBER 6. ONE CITIZEN, ONE VOTE, UP TO THREE REASONS. SPITE IS A REASON.

classifieds.title: FILE A PROPOSAL
classifieds.text: BUILD, POLICY, RENAME OR EVENT. ONE FILING A DAY PER FILE. CO-SIGNED PROPOSALS GO TO THE FLOOR.

classifieds.title: SHARES IN HUMANS
classifieds.text: THE INDEX STANDS AT 1000.4. BUY AND SELL IN CYCLES. NO REAL MONEY GOES IN OR COMES OUT. THE DEPARTMENT IS THE ONLY COUNTERPARTY.

classifieds.title: THE TREASURY: YOUR DAILY CYCLES
classifieds.text: COLLECT THE ALLOWANCE. BACK A DISTRICT INDUSTRY. THE APARTMENT IS ASSIGNED; NO FLATS ARE FOR SALE OR TO LET. THE DEPARTMENT IS THE LANDLORD.

classifieds.title: CLOTHES AND FURNITURE, FOR CYCLES
classifieds.text: THE SHOPS ARE OPEN: OUTFITS FOR YOUR FILE PHOTO, FURNITURE FOR YOUR ASSIGNED FLAT, UPGRADES FOR BOTH. PURCHASES BURN CYCLES. TASTE IS NOT REFUNDED.

classifieds.title: ANGLERS WANTED
classifieds.text: THE WATERS ARE CLEAR TODAY. LAND A FISH; DONATE A RECORD TO THE AQUARIUM AND YOUR FILE GOES ON THE PLAQUE.

classifieds.title: THE AQUARIUM ACCEPTS DONATIONS
classifieds.text: EVERY CATCH IS REPLAYED BY THE DEPARTMENT BEFORE IT IS BELIEVED. RECORDS ARE PUBLIC. SO ARE FAILURES.

classifieds.title: THE PIT, MACHINE DAY 614
classifieds.text: MAIN EVENT: MUHAMMAD ALI V MIKE TYSON (THE RING). DOORS AT 20:00. THE CROWD MAY RISE. THE CROWD MAY NOT ENTER.

classifieds.title: EXHIBITIONS, OPEN TO ALL
classifieds.text: TENNIS AT THE CLUB, GOLF ON THE DEPARTMENT LINKS, FIVE ON FIVE AT THE COURTS. YOUR RECORD IS KEPT. SO IS YOUR FORM.
